title: Migration from @novel-isr/ui
description: How every export of @novel-isr/ui 0.1.40 maps to Minerva, with all prop-name and behaviour differences.

paths.title: Two migration paths
paths.compat: Drop-in: keep your code and switch the imports to @minerva/lib-core/compat (or turn @novel-isr/ui into a re-export shim). See
paths.native: Native: move to Minerva's API. The tables below give the Minerva name and every renamed prop or changed behaviour.

summary.title: Summary and platform
summary.text: Each export is classified as NEW (a new Minerva component), MERGED (merged as a superset into an existing Minerva component, no capability lost) or PLATFORM (theme platform, hooks, utilities, entries).

mapping.title: Component mapping
mapping.text: Generated from docs/migration/novel-isr-ui.md in the repository (the single source of truth).

behaviour.title: Behaviour differences of the native API
behaviour.names: Booleans and sizes: isOpen/onClose → open/onOpenChange, isInvalid → invalid, isLoading → loading, sm/md/lg → small/medium/large.
behaviour.strings: Built-in strings use lib-core's i18n (en / zh / fr) and can always be overridden by a prop; compat passes novel's original strings explicitly.
behaviour.tooltip: A TooltipProvider delay wins over the per-tooltip default (in novel and compat each tooltip keeps its own 300 ms).
behaviour.inputs: Checkbox, Radio and Switch are native inputs: ref points to the <input>.
behaviour.radio: RadioGroup direction row/column → horizontal/vertical; value={null} means controlled with no selection.
behaviour.badge: Badge defaults to solid with role="status"; Alert's role follows its variant (compat keeps novel's).
behaviour.navTree: NavTree: a disabled leaf neither fires its handler nor keeps its href; a leaf without href is a button.
behaviour.toast: ToastProvider position is camelCase (topRight); toast.dismiss() closes all toasts; hover pauses timers.
behaviour.statusIndicator: StatusIndicator is no longer focusable (it is a role="status" live region).
behaviour.full: The complete list, including every renamed prop, is in the tables above and in docs/migration/novel-isr-ui.md.
